meta.name: capital-allocation
meta.description: Evaluates where to spend limited capital — investment appraisal, hurdle rates, payback, and comparing proposals that are not alike. Use this to evaluate an investment or major purchase, compare competing funding requests, set a hurdle rate, decide between building and buying, or review whether past investments delivered what was claimed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估投资与采购,合理分配每一笔资金
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要决定把钱投向哪个项目或评估一笔大额采购是否值得。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate investments and allocate limited capital wisely.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must rank investment opportunities and set hurdle rates.

howto.what: 评估投资或重大购置时，Claude会忽略沉没成本，只按增量现金流分析，用净现值做决策，回收期用于衡量风险；它还能比较不同方案，并在审批后复查结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求评估投资或大宗购买、比较竞争性资金请求、设定门槛回报率等资本配置问题时触发。

say.text: 用增量现金流法评估这个新项目的投资价值。
say.note: 会忽略沉没成本，看增量现金流。

say.text: 比较这两个扩建方案，哪个更值得投钱？
say.note: 会用净现值排序并留意回收期风险。

say.text: 帮我们设定一个合理的门槛回报率。
say.note: 按项目自身风险来定，而不是公司统一利率。

howto.what_en: When spending limited capital, Claude ignores sunk costs, uses incremental cash flow, decides by NPV, treats payback as risk exposure, compares unlike proposals, and reviews past outcomes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when evaluating investments or major purchases, comparing competing funding requests, setting a hurdle rate, or similar capital-allocation questions.

say_en.text: Evaluate this new project using incremental cash flow.
say_en.note: Ignores sunk costs and focuses on what changes.
Ranks by NPV and checks payback for risk.

say_en.text: Set a reasonable hurdle rate for us.
say_en.note: Use project-specific risk, not one company-wide rate.
